tasks.content: Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md section 'Key Types'. Replace the existing types/index.ts with the flashcard type definitions: LearningMode ('flip' | 'spaced-repetition'), Theme (id, name, cards[]), Card (id, front, back), SessionResult (cardId, known, timestamp). Export all types. Ensure TypeScript strict mode compiles without errors.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-1-foundation/slice.md. Create the directory apps/flashcards/app/src/data/themes/ and write world-capitals.json with: id='world-capitals', name='World Capitals', and a cards array with at least 10 country/capital pairs. Each card has id, front (country name), back (capital city). This is the theme data for the app.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md section 'Hooks'. Create src/hooks/useLearningMode.ts that: accepts a LearningMode ('flip' | 'spaced-repetition'), returns timing/scheduling logic appropriate for each mode. For 'flip' mode: simple tap to reveal. For 'spaced-repetition': schedule based on known/unknown results. Export the hook. Write unit tests in useLearningMode.test.ts.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md section 'Hooks'. Create src/hooks/useTheme.ts that: loads world-capitals.json theme data, provides current theme state, theme selection method. Export the hook. Write unit tests in useTheme.test.ts.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md section 'Hooks'. Create src/hooks/useSession.ts that: manages session state (current card index, results array), records SessionResult on each card (known/unknown), persists to localStorage, preserves theme and mode selection across sessions. Export the hook. Write unit tests in useSession.test.ts.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-2-home/slice.md and apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/us-001-home-screen.md. Replace src/screens/HomeScreen.tsx with: ThemePicker showing 'World Capitals', ModeSelector showing 'flip' mode (default), Start button that navigates to /session using react-router-dom Link. Use @primer/react components (Card, Button) and existing UI primitives. The component uses useTheme and useLearningMode hooks. Write tests alongside.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-3-session-results/slice.md and apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/us-002-session-flip.md. Create src/screens/SessionScreen.tsx that: displays FlashcardDisplay (country name), shows ProgressBar (X/Y), shows ScoreButtons after card flip, uses useSession hook to advance through cards. Navigate to /results when session completes (all cards answered). Write tests alongside.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-3-session-results/slice.md. Create src/components/FlashcardDisplay.tsx: renders card front (country name) with tap/click to flip animation revealing back (capital). Use CSS transitions for flip effect. Props: card (Card type), onFlip callback. Write tests alongside.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-3-session-results/slice.md. Create src/components/ScoreButtons.tsx: two buttons 'I knew it' and 'I didn't know'. On click, call onScore(known: boolean). Use @primer/react Button components. Write tests alongside.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-3-session-results/slice.md. Create src/components/ProgressBar.tsx: displays current position (e.g., '3/10'). Props: current (number), total (number). Use progress styling from globals.css. Write tests alongside.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/slices/slice-3-session-results/slice.md and apps/flashcards/docs/what/epics/epic-0-mvp/user-stories/us-003-results-screen.md. Create src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx that: displays X/Y known score, 'Replay' button restarts session (resets useSession state), 'Back to Home' button navigates to /. Uses useSession hook to read results. Write tests alongside.

Read apps/flashcards/docs/how/architecture.md section 'Routes'. Update src/main.tsx: add lazy imports for SessionScreen and ResultsScreen, add routes /session (SessionScreen) and /results (ResultsScreen), remove /demo and /help routes (keep /about), ensure HomeScreen remains on / route. Also update src/components/layout/Header.tsx nav: keep Home and About, remove Help and Demo links. Run 'npm run build' to verify no TypeScript errors.
